about: The Workbench icons of the SeaDefender drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/seadefender.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a warship at dusk firing at incoming missiles, one bursting overhead) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/seadefender.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. SeaDefender-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, SeaDefender.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's SeaDefender.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for Controls, the licence files and README-SeaDefender.txt.
